# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Miraculous Honeycomb; Bees from Paradise

---

**1** The man of God said: 'Bring me the honeycomb.' Aseneth brought it and placed it before him.

**2** The man of God stretched out his right hand, broke off a piece of the honeycomb, put it to Aseneth's mouth, and said: 'Eat.' And she ate.

**3** The man said: 'Behold, you have now eaten the bread of life and drunk the cup of immortality and been anointed with the ointment of incorruption. From this day your flesh will bloom like flowers of life from the ground of the Most High, and your bones will be strong like cedars of God's paradise of delight, and unwearying powers will serve you all your days, your youth will not grow old, and your beauty will never fade.'

**4** Aseneth was filled with great joy at these words.

**5** The man of God said to her: 'Do you see this honeycomb?' She said: 'I see it, lord.' He said: 'This comb is made of the honey of paradise. The angels of God eat of it, and whoever eats of it will not die.'

**6** The man touched the honeycomb, and white bees arose from its cells — white as snow, with wings of violet and purple and scarlet and gold — and they wore golden crowns on their heads, and they had stings sharp as iron.

**7** The bees flew around and settled on Aseneth from her feet to her head, while other great and very large bees encircled her and ate from the honeycomb.

**8** The man of God said to the bees: 'Go now to your place.' Immediately all the bees rose up and flew away to the heavens.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
